Title: Tanay's Day

Cast

1. Tanay - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Nitin - 38 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Rohan - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Tanay stands in the courtyard. Pallavi, Nitin and Rohan stand near him.]

Nitin: "Let's do something fun today."

[Tanay hugs Mother tightly.]

Rohan: "Yes, all right."

[Tanay scratches his head.]

Tanay (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Tanay shouts angrily.]

Nitin (gently): "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Tanay stands in the living room. Pallavi, Nitin and Rohan stand near him.]

Tanay: "So, here we are!"

[Tanay sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Nitin: "Rohan, listen!"

[Tanay mops the floor.]

Pallavi: "What next?"

[Tanay irons his school shirt.]

Tanay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
